# Release report — AML Radar v0.1

Published 5 October 2026.

- Public demo: https://aml-radar-arash.arashamini.chatgpt.site
- Source: https://github.com/arash2079/financial-crime-anomaly-detection
- Reviewed/merged implementation: https://github.com/arash2079/financial-crime-anomaly-detection/pull/1
- Successful GitHub Actions verification: https://github.com/arash2079/financial-crime-anomaly-detection/actions/runs/37322625050

## Delivered

The original synthetic-data pipeline was trained on 37,320 chronological records.
Seven baseline/ablation results are generated by executable evaluation. Exported
LR/RF models run locally in a worker. The interface offers a separate 1,044-record
scenario, model and budget selection, bounded CSV, historical graph inspection,
amount perturbation, methodology and measured evaluation.

## Verification

11 Python unit tests, 12 Node parser/ranking/worker integration tests, 14 additional
causal/schema checks and all 1,044-row Python/JS parity checks passed locally.
GitHub Actions job `verify` completed successfully for implementation commit
`bf2f596cdd0abdd62568dde27d0bef06374461e2`; PR #1 was merged as
`6b95d7bb2a94c8b4fdf9359ff54a687ea33fe48d`. Main-branch app content was read back
and matched the submitted source. Independent retraining and audit findings are
recorded in AUDIT.md; later assembly/worker evidence is in INTEGRATION.md.

The native hosting system confirmed initial deployment `succeeded` and returned
the public URL above. No browser navigation or HTTP fetch of the deployed Site
was used to claim end-to-end correctness.

## Measured simulator result

Historical Random Forest AP 0.4185; amount-only RF AP 0.1031. At a 5% review
budget, historical RF retrieved 189 of 504 planted positives among 374 alerts:
precision 50.5%, recall 37.5%. These figures are simulator-only. Isolation Forest
was weak; its results remain visible.

## Remaining work

IBM data acquisition/external benchmarking, repeated-seed uncertainty, shift and
unseen-entity experiments remain pending. Real-browser visual/E2E/accessibility,
deployed network/CSP behavior and dependency vulnerability scanning were not run.
Optional WebMCP supported-browser validation was unavailable. The project is a
research prototype, not a production AML system or calibrated crime predictor.

AI implementation assistance and owner contribution are documented explicitly.
This initial release is not represented as completed external research validation.
